parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the page to return. Default value: **1**, which indicates the first page.

parameters.name: Lang
parameters.description:
The language type for the request and response messages. Default value: **zh**. Valid values:

- **zh**: Chinese
- **en**: English.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description:
The maximum number of entries per page for a paged query. Maximum value: 1000. Default value: 20. If you leave this parameter empty, 20 entries are returned.

> Do not leave PageSize empty.

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The source IP address of the request. You do not need to specify this parameter. The system automatically obtains this value.

parameters.name: StrategyIds
parameters.description:
The policy ID.
>You can call the [DescribeWhiteListStrategyList](~~DescribeWhiteListStrategyList~~) operation to obtain this parameter.
